description: This file was a bare $schema stanza until August 2026, which meant Renovate ran with no preset and opened one PR per package.

Six @docusaurus/* packages are released in lockstep, so that produced six PRs for one version bump — and merging any of them alone left the docs site with a peer mismatch (core@3.10.2 against preset-classic@3.9.2) while invalidating the other five lockfiles, costing a rebase and a CI run each.
config:recommended pulls in group:monorepos, which knows @docusaurus/* is one monorepo and groups it. The rule below covers the one grouping Renovate cannot infer on its own.

TypeScript 7 removed the baseUrl compiler option, and @docusaurus/tsconfig 3.10.2 still sets it. Because TypeScript cannot unset an inherited option, docs-site/tsconfig.json cannot work around it while it extends the Docusaurus config, and `npm run typecheck` fails outright (TS5102).
The bump is also invisible to CI on its own: docusaurus build strips types via babel without checking them, so a TS7 PR builds a green site. #355 is the one that surfaced this.
Drop this pin once Docusaurus ships a tsconfig without baseUrl; Renovate will re-propose v7 on its own.

packageRules.description: The toolchain directive in both go.mod files and the golang base image in the Dockerfile are one decision. Split across two PRs, a build image a minor behind the directive either downloads a second toolchain at build time or fails outright under GOTOOLCHAIN=local.
